_doc: Repairs applied by `rv import` every time it runs (docs/DESIGN.md: nothing is edited in printed files). move = English that the old file had under the wrong heading; set_aside = English with no counterpart in the edition (kept in the data, not printed); add_en = English supplied for a unit the old file left empty (headword in Kannada script as in the source, then the meaning).

move.why: two paragraphs of the Special Topics of Ṛk 1 (Pracetasam, Viśvaṃ janata) stood after the heading of Ṛk 2 in the old file
the introduction of Sūkta 15 (the rite Paryagnikaraṇa) stood under the Special Topics of 4.14.5 in the old file; in the edition it opens Sūkta 15

set_aside.why: a list drawn from the grammatical tail of the bhāṣya; the edition has no grammar section here and the bhāṣya is printed in full

add_en.why: the old file had no word meanings for this Ṛk; supplied Nov 13 2026 from the Kannada, to be read a second time with the rest
lines: when fear caused by Vṛtra arose
you have upheld for their protection
across the regions of flowing water
